name: diba
description: Diba — Kaladan's design system, component library, and cross-platform rendering contract.

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@kaladan/diba-tokens' build && bun run --filter '@kaladan/diba-schema' build && bun run --filter '@kaladan/diba-react' build
scripts.release: cd packages/tokens && bun publish --tolerate-republish && cd ../schema && bun publish --tolerate-republish && cd ../react && bun publish --tolerate-republish
